records.text: TPUSA was going in a different direction, the employee had been terminated, and the employee had to leave.
records.speaker: Frank (TPUSA lawyer; surname unverified)

records.text: The former TPUSA employee had worked 80- to 90-hour weeks for AMFest, received no direction after Charlie Kirk's death, and bent over backwards for the organization.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep gG4ZoYUjUc8)

appearances.snippet: I just worked. series of 80 90 hour weeks plus for infest I've ... had no direction or explanation since we've come back our CEO has been assassinated I've done nothing but then either backwards for this organization and the point where I'm wondering if this is a prank so

verification.notes: Transcript context records the unidentified former employee making these claims during termination. Current searches found repetitions of the recording but no time records, management documents, or identified witness evidence independently confirming the claimed hours or post-assassination lack of direction.

records.text: The former TPUSA employee had never received a bad review, had no issue with the company, had done nothing unethical, and was terminated with no warning.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep gG4ZoYUjUc8)

appearances.snippet: But there's no explanation or documentation for this. I've never had one bad review from Dylan. I've never had one issue with the company. I've never done anything unethical. And so I'm sitting here understanding why my entire livelihood is being completely tossed out. ... my paycheck every other week is being tossed out, Frank, but absolutely no warning whatsoever.

verification.notes: The direct recording confirms an abrupt termination, the employees contemporaneous assertion of no warning, and counsels refusal to give a substantive explanation. The claims of never receiving a bad review, never having an issue, and doing nothing unethical remain self-report without personnel records.
